newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backeds drift higher on light Monday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backeds drift higher on light Monday.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backeds drifted upward in lazy pre-holiday trading on Monday, traders and analysts said.
Overall, mortgages rose about 1/32 to 5/32 by late afternoon, widening to comparable Treasuries.
Gold 7.0 percent coupons continued to get squeezed, but that was about the only news, traders said.
"There's a bid for November 1996 production Gold 7.0s up six plus ticks," one trader said. About $4 billion of the securities have been bid over the past several weeks, he said.
